_comment: Co-template hints. task_* may pair with method_* for non-PBE functionals. minimal_* are fallbacks when user provides no input_file; structure/basis/potential are filled by prepare_*.

cp2k/minimal_periodic.inp.hint: Minimal periodic CP2K template. Use when user provides no input_file. Structure, basis, potential are placeholders; prepare_cp2k_job overwrites them.

cp2k/task_band.inp.hint: TASK template (PBE k-path). Pair with a method_ template for the functional.

cp2k/task_scf.inp.hint: TASK template (basic PBE SCF). For a different functional, fetch the corresponding method_ template.

cp2k/task_opt.inp.hint: TASK template (PBE geometry optimization). For hybrid or meta-GGA, fetch the corresponding method_ template.

cp2k/task_cellopt.inp.hint: TASK template (PBE cell optimization). For a different functional, fetch the corresponding method_ template.

cp2k/task_md_nvt.inp.hint: TASK template (PBE NVT MD). For a different functional, fetch a method_ template.

cp2k/method_admm_pbe0.inp.hint: METHOD template (ADMM+PBE0). Merge XC/ADMM/HF sections into a task_ template.

cp2k/method_admm_hse06.inp.hint: METHOD template (ADMM+HSE06). Merge into a task_ template.

cp2k/method_r2scan.inp.hint: METHOD template (r2SCAN meta-GGA). Merge XC sections into a task_ template.

cp2k/method_dft_plus_u.inp.hint: METHOD template (DFT+U). Merge DFT+U sections into a task_ template.

orca/minimal_molecule.inp.hint: Minimal ORCA molecule template. Use when user provides no input_file. Coordinates are placeholder; prepare_orca_job overwrites them.

orca/std_dft.inp.hint: Molecular ground-state DFT base template (B3LYP/def2-TZVP, RIJCOSX). Use as starting point for single-point or geometry-optimisation jobs.

orca/stdft_wb97x-d3.inp.hint: Simplified TD-DFT (sTD-DFT) template using wB97X-D3/def2-SV(P). Covers excitations up to 7 eV with perturbative selection (PThresh/PTLimit). Suitable for UV/Vis spectra of medium-to-large molecules.

orca/tddft_pbe0.inp.hint: Full TD-DFT template (PBE0/def2-SV(P), TDA disabled). For conventional excited-state calculations with a hybrid functional.

abinit/gs_scf.abi.hint: Base ground-state SCF. For NLO/SHG, call prepare_abinit_job with workflow_type='nlo'; do not hand-edit multiple datasets.

lammps/msst_shock.lammps.hint: MSST shock simulation. Use prepare_lammps_job for structure/potential binding.

lammps/gcmc_adsorption.lammps.hint: GCMC adsorption. Use prepare_lammps_job for path binding.
